item.title: Russia blames Ukraine for assassination attempt on top military leader
item.description: His assailant has not been identified, but the attack follows a series of high-profile assassinations of Russian military leaders.

item.title: CHUCK NORRIS: Our founders' wisdom on reducing violent crime (2012)
item.description: We must be equally willing to reach out to those lost souls who feel marginalized and disenfranchised by the world around them.

item.title: VANESSA BATTAGLIA: Cuba should take a deal or face President Trump's 'big stick' diplomacy
item.description: Cuba could take a deal, the terms of which, of course, have not been disclosed. Or Cuba could let the Sword of Damocles (Don-ocles?) fall.

item.title: Algerian gold medal-winning 'women's' Olympic boxer Imane Khelif admits to being male
item.description: "I’m not transgender. My difference is natural. I am who I am."

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: Sheriff Mark Lamb reveals Border Patrol Tactical Unit has joined Arizona search for Nancy Guthrie
item.description: BORTAC, a specialized Border Patrol unit, is "extremely proficient at looking for people," Mark Lamb said.

item.title: NANCY GUTHRIE STILL MISSING: Sheriff Lamb tells Jack Posobiec 90% of abduction cases involve suspect known to victim
item.description: "And honestly, in these cases, 90% or more ... end up being somebody that's familiar to the person, or maybe even sometimes family."

item.title: Pakistani court awards custody of 13-year-old Christian girl to Muslim man who kidnapped, raped her, forced her into marriage
item.description: The justices accepted a statement made by Maria Shahbaz, which her parents claim was made under coercion, that she converted to Islam and consented to the marriage of 30-year-old Shehryar Ahmad.

item.title: Rioters set off fireworks, throw smoke bombs at police in Milan during anti-Olympics unrest
item.description: Footage from the scene showed police in riot gear holding shields to push back against roughly 100 protesters and using a water cannon in an effort to disperse the crowd.

item.title: Zelensky defends strikes on Russian energy infrastructure as legitimate military targets
item.description: "We either build weapons and strike their weapons. Or we strike the source where their money is generated and multiplied."

item.title: Japan cancels Mount Fuji Cherry Blossom Festival due to 'crisis' of unruly tourists
item.description: City officials said visitor behavior has crossed a line and begun seriously disrupting daily life.
